mapper.insert: update DOC_FILEINFO_KZ set clbz = #{clbz}, rootpath = #{rootpath}, filepath = #{filepath}, filehash = #{filehash}, crtime = #{crtime}, downloadnum = #{downloadnum} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select h.id,h.nsrdzdah,h.sbywb_dm,to_char(h.sbpc)as sbpc,to_char(sbrq,'yyyy-MM-dd') as sbrq,sssq as sbym,s.sbbw,c.nsrsbh, c.nsrdjno,c.qyhgdm as cpcode,c.swjg_dm as swcode,c.qylx_dm,c.nsrmc as cpname,c.shxyno,kz.kzxx from sb_sbxx_hz h inner join sb_sbxx_sbsj s on (h.id = s.id) left join gs_dj_cktmsdab c on (c.nsrdzdah = h.nsrdzdah) left join gs_dj_cktmsdab_kz kz on (c.nsrdzdah = kz.nsrdzdah and kz.kzlx = 'WZHQY' and kz.flag = '1' and sysdate between kz.st_date and kz.end_date) where h.id = #{id} and rownum = 1
